scenario: [LCST.4.5.2]: `Duration -> Int` is total and gives the nanoseconds, and `(a - b)::Int - (b - a)::Int` is the signed difference of two instants ([LTIM.1.3.1]), because one of the two differences is `0_s`. One W, `a` at 1 s and `b` at 6 s, so `a` is the earlier. Rule `signed` logs the signed difference from `b` to `a`, `-5000000000`, and its reverse, `5000000000`; rule `ahead` fires where that difference is below zero, the way an author asks how far early `a` is. PATH PINNED: `dsc.cast`'s `Duration -> Int` row and `dsc.rete`'s `lcst_4_5_2_lower` (the identity on the nanoseconds), over the saturated `Time - Time` of [RLOW.6.1.6].
rules_ds:
schema W scope logical:
    id: Int key
    a: Time mutable
    b: Time mutable

rule signed:
    W w
->
    let back = (w.a - w.b)::Int - (w.b - w.a)::Int
    let fwd = (w.b - w.a)::Int - (w.a - w.b)::Int
    log info "signed {back} {fwd}"

rule ahead:
    W w where (w.a - w.b)::Int - (w.b - w.a)::Int < 0
->
    log info "ahead"
